title: CheckBox
description: Fiori check box with indeterminate, read-only and value states; Space/Enter toggle.

usage.summary: Select independent options, including choices reviewed before submission.
useWhen: Let users select or deselect independent options or accept an unambiguous statement.
Keep all options visible when users need to compare them before choosing.
Collect changes that users review and confirm before submission.
Use checked="indeterminate" for a parent option when only some child options are selected.

avoidWhen.when: Choose exactly one answer from a visible set.
Activate or deactivate a secondary toolbar feature.
Run an explicit action rather than select an option.
Adjust a numeric value along a visual scale rather than choose categorical options.
